_comment: Annotated example. Tiers restore low->high; `needs` expresses real edges. NOTE: min_files should be a TIGHT bound (~5% churn), not half the file count — a loose bound lets a tree lose most of its contents and still pass. `swr add` computes this for you; prefer --merkle when silent drift is unacceptable.

_tier_legend.0: credentials, PATH shims - everything else depends on these
_tier_legend.1: scripts - usually just a lost exec bit, cheapest fix
_tier_legend.4: build artifacts - require tier 2 source to be healthy first

entries._kind_note: file = sha256 + exec-bit check. Add `escrow` for small files you cannot rebuild from a recipe: the content travels inside the manifest and survives a total wipe.
entries.escrow: <zlib+base64 of the file, set by `swr escrow`>

entries._kind_note: tier 0 secret. The restore recipe re-authenticates, it does not just rewrite the file.
entries.restore: mkdir -p ~/.clawhub && printf '%s\n' "$CLAWHUB_TOKEN" > ~/.clawhub/TOKEN && chmod 600 ~/.clawhub/TOKEN && export PATH=$HOME/.shim:$PATH && npx clawhub@latest login --token "$(cat ~/.clawhub/TOKEN)"

entries._kind_note: blob = exact byte count + head/tail hash. Avoids hashing gigabytes every turn, but still catches same-size corruption. `upstream` lets `swr add` fetch the authoritative size instead of trusting the local file.
entries.fragile: large blob (484 MB) - likely exceeds snapshot size cap

entries._kind_note: tree + sentinels = THE important one. Catches a directory that survives while its contents are emptied. Sentinels are only a SAMPLE, so pin files from risky subdirs (note ggml/src below) and set a tight min_files, or use `merkle` for exact detection.
entries.fragile: subdir 'src' can be swept by exclusion rules, leaving an empty shell

entries._kind_note: tier 4 build output; 'build' is on every exclusion list. `needs` means a failed llama-src SKIPS this instead of running a doomed 6-min build.
entries.restore: cd ~/llama.cpp && cmake -B build -DLLAMA_BUILD_SERVER=OFF -DLLAMA_SERVER=OFF >/dev/null && for t in llama-simple llama-simple-chat llama-bench llama-completion; do cmake --build build --config Release --target $t -j 2 >/dev/null 2>&1; done

entries._kind_note: Package installs. Count with `find -name SKILL.md`, never `ls | wc -l` — scoped names nest as skills/@scope/name/. Sentinels should include at least one SCOPED path, since those install differently.
entries.restore: cd ~ && export PATH=$HOME/.shim:$PATH && while read s; do npx clawhub@latest install "$s" --no-input >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "FAIL $s"; done < ~/all_skills_restore.txt
